description: This file defines the QuotaManager class, which manages retry quotas for AWS SDK operations, controlling rate limiting and retry behavior.

classes.name: QuotaManager
classes.description: Manages retry quotas to control AWS SDK rate limiting and retry logic based on available capacity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the quota manager with configuration options such as initial retry tokens, retry costs, and no-retry increments.

methods.name: hasRetryQuota
methods.description: Determines if another retry can be made based on current available capacity and the result's error type.

methods.name: releaseToQuota
methods.description: Releases quota back after a request completes successfully, adjusting the available capacity accordingly.

methods.name: getAvailableCapacity
methods.description: Returns the current available capacity for retries.
